title: Find the release still serving
brief: Find the unhealthy shop Application, compare the old and new Pods, and identify which revision is still serving during the failed rollout.

checks.question: Which Application is unhealthy?
checks.hint: Find the shop Application for the selected environment.
checks.why: The Applications list identifies which release needs inspection.

checks.question: What health status does this Application show?
checks.hint: Read the health badge in the Application header.
checks.why: The health badge helps determine whether the rollout has become ready.

checks.question: How many Pods under Deployment/django are Healthy?
checks.hint: In Tree, compare the health indicators on the two Pods under Deployment/django.
checks.why: Service/django sends traffic only to Ready Pods; compare Pod health before deciding which release serves.

checks.question: Which Git revision is still serving the shop service?
checks.hint: Compare the newest and previous distinct Revision entries with the Pod health you observed.
checks.why: History records Git syncs; Pod readiness determines which release can receive traffic.

truth.cause: The new rollout is failing its readiness probe
truth.evidence: ${health} health; older Pod Healthy; new Pod unready; ${revision} synced; ${serving_revision} still serving
